import Mathlib

namespace OAI

noncomputable section

universe level

namespace RelativeGeneration

variable {Hilbert : Type level} [NormedAddCommGroup Hilbert]
  [InnerProductSpace ℂ Hilbert] [CompleteSpace Hilbert]

/-- Weak operator closedness of a concrete unital star subalgebra. -/
def WOTClosed (algebra : StarSubalgebra ℂ (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert)) : Prop :=
  IsClosed {operator : Hilbert →WOT[ℂ] Hilbert | operator.toCLM ∈ algebra}

/-- The weakly closed unital star algebra generated by a set of operators. -/
def wstar (operators : Set (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert)) :
    StarSubalgebra ℂ (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert) :=
  sInf {algebra | WOTClosed algebra ∧ operators ⊆ algebra}

/-- A nonzero, weakly closed, finite diffuse algebra with scalar center. -/
structure IsII1Factor (algebra : StarSubalgebra ℂ (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert)) : Prop where
  nonzero : (0 : Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert) ≠ 1
  weaklyClosed : WOTClosed algebra
  factor : ∀ element : algebra, (∀ other : algebra, other * element = element * other) →
    ∃ scalar : ℂ, element = algebraMap ℂ algebra scalar
  finite : ∀ isometry : algebra, star isometry * isometry = 1 → isometry * star isometry = 1
  diffuse : ∀ projection : algebra, IsStarProjection projection → projection ≠ 0 →
    ∃ subprojection : algebra, IsStarProjection subprojection ∧ subprojection ≠ 0 ∧
      subprojection ≠ projection ∧ projection * subprojection = subprojection ∧
      subprojection * projection = subprojection

/-- A same-universe separable Banach predual, with the conjugate-linear dual convention.
This imposes no separability on the Hilbert representation or the operator norm topology. -/
def HasSeparablePredual (algebra : StarSubalgebra ℂ (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert)) : Prop :=
  ∃ (Banach : Type level) (_ : NormedAddCommGroup Banach) (_ : NormedSpace ℂ Banach)
    (_ : CompleteSpace Banach) (_ : TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace Banach),
    Nonempty (StrongDual ℂ Banach ≃ₗᵢ⋆[ℂ] algebra)

/-- The ultraweak topology is generated by absolutely summable vector functionals. -/
abbrev ultraweakTopology (Hilbert : Type level) [NormedAddCommGroup Hilbert]
    [InnerProductSpace ℂ Hilbert] [CompleteSpace Hilbert] :
    TopologicalSpace (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert) :=
  ⨅ (left : ℕ → Hilbert) (right : ℕ → Hilbert)
    (_ : Summable (fun index => ‖left index‖ * ‖right index‖)),
    TopologicalSpace.induced
      (fun operator : Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert =>
        ∑' index, inner ℂ (left index) (operator (right index))) inferInstance

/-- The concrete algebra carries the induced ultraweak topology. -/
abbrev algebraUltraweakTopology (algebra : StarSubalgebra ℂ (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert)) :
    TopologicalSpace algebra :=
  TopologicalSpace.induced (fun operator : algebra => (operator : Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert))
    (ultraweakTopology Hilbert)

/-- A faithful normal normalized trace, not an additional hypothesis on the inclusion. -/
structure IsNormalizedTrace (algebra : StarSubalgebra ℂ (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert))
    (trace : algebra →L[ℂ] ℂ) : Prop where
  normalized : trace 1 = 1
  positive : ∀ element : algebra, 0 ≤ (trace (star element * element)).re
  star_preserving : ∀ element : algebra, trace (star element) = star (trace element)
  tracial : ∀ left right : algebra, trace (left * right) = trace (right * left)
  faithful : ∀ element : algebra, trace (star element * element) = 0 → element = 0
  normal : @Continuous algebra ℂ (algebraUltraweakTopology algebra) inferInstance trace

/-- The normalized trace two-distance between genuine unitaries of the original algebra. -/
def traceDistance (algebra : StarSubalgebra ℂ (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert))
    (trace : algebra →L[ℂ] ℂ) (left right : unitary algebra) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (trace (star ((left : algebra) - (right : algebra)) *
    ((left : algebra) - (right : algebra)))).re

/-- The topology generated by trace two-distance balls, not the inherited operator norm topology. -/
abbrev traceTopology (algebra : StarSubalgebra ℂ (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert))
    (trace : algebra →L[ℂ] ℂ) : TopologicalSpace (unitary algebra) :=
  TopologicalSpace.generateFrom {ball | ∃ center : unitary algebra, ∃ radius : ℝ,
    0 < radius ∧ ball = {point | traceDistance algebra trace center point < radius}}

/-- The entire relative-generator locus in the original unitary group. -/
def relativeGeneratorLocus (small large : StarSubalgebra ℂ (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert)) :
    Set (unitary large) :=
  {element | wstar ((small : Set (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert)) ∪
    {((element : large) : Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert)}) = large}

/-- Every irreducible inclusion of concrete type II₁ factors with separable predual
of the larger factor has a dense Gδ full relative-generator locus in the normalized
trace two-topology. The normalized faithful normal trace is asserted to exist;
no representation, transport, cyclicity, or perturbation premise is imposed. -/
def MainTarget : Prop :=
  ∀ (Hilbert : Type level) [NormedAddCommGroup Hilbert] [InnerProductSpace ℂ Hilbert]
    [CompleteSpace Hilbert] (small large : StarSubalgebra ℂ (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert)),
    IsII1Factor small → IsII1Factor large → ∀ inclusion : small ≤ large,
      (∀ element : large,
        (∀ member : small, StarSubalgebra.inclusion inclusion member * element =
          element * StarSubalgebra.inclusion inclusion member) →
        ∃ scalar : ℂ, element = algebraMap ℂ large scalar) →
      HasSeparablePredual large →
      ∃ trace : large →L[ℂ] ℂ, IsNormalizedTrace large trace ∧
        @IsGδ (unitary large) (traceTopology large trace) (relativeGeneratorLocus small large) ∧
        @Dense (unitary large) (traceTopology large trace) (relativeGeneratorLocus small large)

theorem main_theorem : MainTarget.{level} := by
  sorry

end RelativeGeneration

end

end OAI

import OAI.Analysis.FactorGeneration.Main
import OAI.Analysis.RelativeGeneration.InclusionTransport
import OAI.Analysis.RelativeGeneration.OriginalUnitary
import OAI.Analysis.RelativeGeneration.RepresentedLocus

namespace OAI

noncomputable section

/- The full relative-generating locus of the original inclusion,
   together with the single-generation corollary. -/
namespace Generator
open Tracial UltrapowerBridge
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Relative generation for the original concrete
factors and the arbitrary given irreducible inclusion. No ambient separability,
cyclicity, or perturbation hypothesis appears. The entire generating locus is
Gδ and dense, for the metric identified with normalized trace-2 in
`FactorTraceUnitary.dist_eq_trace`. -/
theorem relative_generation_of_II1_separable_predual
    (P S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H)) (hP : IsII1Factor P) (hS : IsII1Factor S)
    (hPS : P ≤ S)
    (hirr : ∀ c : S,
      (∀ a : P,StarSubalgebra.inclusion hPS a*c=c*StarSubalgebra.inclusion hPS a) →
      ∃ z : ℂ,c=algebraMap ℂ S z)
    (hsep : HasSeparablePredual S) :
    IsGδ {u : FactorTraceUnitary S hS |
      wstar ((P : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) ∪ {(u.algebra S hS).val})=S} ∧
    Dense {u : FactorTraceUnitary S hS |
      wstar ((P : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) ∪ {(u.algebra S hS).val})=S} := by
  let hf := hS.factor_smul
  let hu := hS.one_ne_zero
  let K := TraceFreeHilbert hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hu
  let R := traceFreeHilbertClosure hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hu
  let σ := traceFreeHilbertClosureTrace hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hu
  let N := traceFreeRelativeImage hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hu P hP.weaklyClosed
  have hNR : N ≤ R := traceFreeRelativeImage_le hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hu P hP.weaklyClosed
  have hN : IsII1Factor N.toStarSubalgebra :=
    traceFreeRelativeImage_isII1Factor hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hu P hP.weaklyClosed hPS hP
  have hfN : ∀ c : N.toStarSubalgebra,
      (∀ a : N.toStarSubalgebra,a*c=c*a) → ∃ z : ℂ,c=z • (1 : N.toStarSubalgebra) := by
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := hN.factor c hc
    exact ⟨z,hz.trans (Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one z)⟩
  have hirr' : ∀ c : S,
      (∀ a : P,StarSubalgebra.inclusion hPS a*c=c*StarSubalgebra.inclusion hPS a) →
      ∃ z : ℂ,c=z • (1 : S) := by
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := hirr c hc
    exact ⟨z,hz.trans (Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one z)⟩
  have hi := traceFreeRelativeImage_irreducible hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hu
    P hP.weaklyClosed hPS hirr'
  have hs := traceOrbit_isSeparable_of_separablePredual σ
    (traceFreeHilbertClosure_hasSeparablePredual hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hu hsep)
  obtain ⟨hg,hd⟩ := represented_full_relative_generation σ hNR hfN hN.diffuse hi hs
  let f := FactorTraceUnitary.representedHomeomorph S hS
  have he : {u : FactorTraceUnitary S hS |
      wstar ((P : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) ∪ {(u.algebra S hS).val})=S} =
      f ⁻¹' {v : TraceUnitary σ |
        wstar ((N : Set (K →L[ℂ] K)) ∪ {(v.algebra σ).val})=R.toStarSubalgebra} := by
    ext u
    exact traceFreeRelativeGeneration_iff hf hS.diffuse hS.finite hu P hP.weaklyClosed hPS
      (u.algebra S hS)
  rw [he]
  exact ⟨IsGδ.preimage f.continuous hg, f.isOpenQuotientMap.dense_preimage_iff.mpr hd⟩

/-- A factor with separable predual is singly generated, equivalently
   generated by two self-adjoint elements. -/
theorem source_main_reused (S : StarSubalgebra ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (hS : IsII1Factor S) (hsep : HasSeparablePredual S) :
    SinglyGenerated S ∧ ∃ a ∈ S, ∃ b ∈ S,
      IsSelfAdjoint a ∧ IsSelfAdjoint b ∧ wstar {a,b}=S := by
  have h := single_generation_of_II1_separable_predual S hS hsep
  exact ⟨h,(singlyGenerated_iff_two_selfAdjoint S).mp h⟩

end Generator

namespace RelativeGeneration

universe level

/-- The concrete finite diffuse factor hypotheses are the ones used in the trace construction. -/
theorem IsII1Factor.toGenerator {Hilbert : Type level} [NormedAddCommGroup Hilbert]
    [InnerProductSpace ℂ Hilbert] [CompleteSpace Hilbert]
    {algebra : StarSubalgebra ℂ (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert)} (factor : IsII1Factor algebra) :
    Generator.IsII1Factor algebra :=
  ⟨factor.nonzero, factor.weaklyClosed, factor.factor, factor.finite, factor.diffuse⟩

/-- The entire relative-generator locus of an irreducible inclusion is dense Gδ in the
normalized trace two-topology on the original, genuine unitaries. -/
theorem main_theorem : MainTarget.{level} := by
  intro Hilbert _ _ _ small large smallFactor largeFactor inclusion irreducible separablePredual
  let smallFactor' := smallFactor.toGenerator
  let largeFactor' := largeFactor.toGenerator
  obtain ⟨gdelta, dense⟩ := Generator.relative_generation_of_II1_separable_predual
    small large smallFactor' largeFactor' inclusion irreducible separablePredual
  refine ⟨Generator.normalizedFactorTrace large largeFactor',
    Generator.normalizedFactorTrace_isNormalizedTrace large largeFactor', ?_⟩
  let : TopologicalSpace (unitary large) :=
    traceTopology large (Generator.normalizedFactorTrace large largeFactor')
  let unitaryHomeomorph := Generator.FactorTraceUnitary.traceHomeomorph large largeFactor'
  have locus_eq : relativeGeneratorLocus small large = unitaryHomeomorph.symm ⁻¹'
      {element : Generator.FactorTraceUnitary large largeFactor' |
        Generator.wstar ((small : Set (Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert)) ∪
          {(element.algebra large largeFactor').val}) = large} := by
    ext element
    rfl
  rw [locus_eq]
  exact ⟨IsGδ.preimage unitaryHomeomorph.symm.continuous gdelta,
    unitaryHomeomorph.symm.isOpenQuotientMap.dense_preimage_iff.mpr dense⟩

end RelativeGeneration

end

end OAI
